@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We decided to stay at a m______l because the rooms there were cheap.
= motel
~詞義 motel（n.）汽車旅館
~原文 We decided to stay at a motel because the rooms there were cheap.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I s______pped a few chapters to find out what happened at the end of the story.
= skipped
~詞義 skip（v.）略過
~原文 I skipped a few chapters to find out what happened at the end of the story.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: In the story, the main character m______red the king with a knife while he was sleeping.
= murdered
~詞義 murder（v.）謀殺
~原文 In the story, the main character murdered the king with a knife while he was sleeping.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tim and Tom are brothers. You can definitely see the s______y between them.
= similarity
~詞義 similarity（n.）相似
~原文 Tim and Tom are brothers. You can definitely see the similarity between them.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Diana enjoys her work as a teacher because she finds it satisfying and m______l.
= meaningful
~詞義 meaningful（adj.）有意義的
~原文 Diana enjoys her work as a teacher because she finds it satisfying and meaningful.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Donna is grateful to her teacher because he always gives her ______ when she faces difficulties.
A: temper
B: dump
C: guidance
D: marker
= C
~詞義 guidance（n.）引導;指引
~原文 Donna is grateful to her teacher because he always gives her guidance when she faces difficulties.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After walking in the sun for one hour, the man drank some water to quench his ______.
A: boot
B: thirst
C: knot
D: ray
= B
~詞義 thirst（n.）口渴
~原文 After walking in the sun for one hour, the man drank some water to quench his thirst.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The movie star's sudden marriage made national ______. Many journalists suddenly wanted to interview her.
A: morals
B: headlines
C: branches
D: skates
= B
~詞義 headline（n.）頭條新聞
~原文 The movie star's sudden marriage made national headlines. Many journalists suddenly wanted to interview her.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Please spit the ______ out. You are not allowed to chew it in class.
A: gum
B: fur
C: hut
D: sin
= A
~詞義 gum（n.）口香糖
~原文 Please spit the gum out. You are not allowed to chew it in class.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Reading is my favorite leisure activity. I like to sit by the window with a book and ______ hot tea.
A: bore
B: glow
C: pave
D: sip
= D
~詞義 sip（v.）啜飲
~原文 Reading is my favorite leisure activity. I like to sit by the window with a book and sip hot tea.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: headquarters
B: blouse
C: meanwhile
D: tenderly
E: ivory
F: paving

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mary keeps an extra ______ in her office in case she accidentally spills something on the one she is wearing.
= B
~詞義 blouse（n.）(女用)襯衫
~原文 Mary keeps an extra blouse in her office in case she accidentally spills something on the one she is wearing.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The construction workers are ______ a new sidewalk in front of the building.
= F
~詞義 pave（v.）鋪(路)
~原文 The construction workers are paving a new sidewalk in front of the building.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many international companies choose to establish their ______ in New York City because it is America's financial center.
= A
~詞義 headquarters（n.）總部
~原文 Many international companies choose to establish their headquarters in New York City because it is America's financial center.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many professors are criticized for living in ______ towers, unaware of the real challenges young people face outside the university.
= E
~詞義 ivory（n.）象牙塔(ivory tower)
~原文 Many professors are criticized for living in ivory towers, unaware of the real challenges young people face outside the university.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The shop does not open until one hour from now; ______, a long line of people has already formed outside, waiting to get in.
= C
~詞義 meanwhile（adv.）與此同時
~原文 The shop does not open until one hour from now; meanwhile, a long line of people has already formed outside, waiting to get in.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: knot
B: immoral
C: peas
D: glowed
E: familiarity
F: waterfalls

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Danny is a picky eater. For example, he won't eat ______ or carrots.
= C
~詞義 pea（n.）豌豆
~原文 Danny is a picky eater. For example, he won't eat peas or carrots.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Alice's ______ with the laboratory allowed the group to finish their science project much faster than the other teams.
= E
~詞義 familiarity（n.）熟悉
~原文 Alice's familiarity with the laboratory allowed the group to finish their science project much faster than the other teams.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: At night, a lantern ______ dimly in the corner of the hut.
= D
~詞義 glow（v.）發光
~原文 At night, a lantern glowed dimly in the corner of the hut.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The principal reminded the students that cheating on exams is not only dishonest but also deeply ______.
= B
~詞義 immoral（adj.）不道德的
~原文 The principal reminded the students that cheating on exams is not only dishonest but also deeply immoral.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mandy told her parents that she planned to tie the ______ with her partner next spring, hoping everyone would support their decision.
= A
~詞義 knot（n.）與某人結婚(tie the knot with sb.)
~原文 Mandy told her parents that she planned to tie the knot with her partner next spring, hoping everyone would support their decision.
